$comment: 听力训练营 L23（P-L3 续跑，阶段三第三课）。脚本 100% 原创；Part 3 观点直说（一段长对话 5 题：为什么不买书 / 觉得围巾怎么样 / 对做蛋糕什么感受 / 为什么去集市买花 / 为什么要自己写卡片）+ Part 5 匹配直给（Emma 告诉 Leo 五个人各送了妈妈什么礼物，8 件物品 A-H 全部被提到，3 个是干扰）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x。
title: A Birthday Present for Mum
intro: 先听 Dan 和姐姐 Emma 商量给妈妈买什么生日礼物：书、围巾、蛋糕还是花？题目问的是「为什么不买」「觉得怎么样」「什么感受」，每样东西都会被说到优点和缺点，要抓住说话人自己最后的态度。再听 Emma 告诉同学 Leo 五个人各送了妈妈什么礼物，把人和礼物配起来——8 件礼物都会被提到，有 3 件没人送。

sections.intro: 听 Dan 和 Emma 商量给妈妈买什么生日礼物。五道题问的是理由和看法，注意每样东西被否定的真正原因是什么。

script.text: Emma, it's Mum's birthday on Sunday. Have you got any ideas for a present? I've only got fifteen pounds.
I was thinking about a book. She loves reading, and her shelf is already full, so she must like them.
She does love reading, but she reads everything on her phone now. She hasn't opened a real book for a year. A full shelf isn't the problem. A new book would just sit there.
OK, you're right. What about that scarf in the shop window on King Street?
The blue one? It's twelve pounds. We could pay for it together.
It's lovely, and the price is fine, but it's blue. Mum never wears blue. She says it makes her look ill. She could wear it next winter, but not if it's blue.
True. She always wears green or red.
So let's make her a birthday cake! Grandma says it's easy if you read the recipe carefully.
I'd like to, but the last time I made a cake, the kitchen was dirty everywhere and the cake was black. I'm worried the same thing will happen again. I've got time on Saturday, that's not the problem.
Then I'll make the cake and you can help. And we can buy some flowers. Let's get them at the market, not at the flower shop.
Why? The flower shop is open on Sunday, and the prices are about the same.
Because the market flowers come from the farm that morning, so they're fresh. They stay nice all week. The shop flowers only last two days.

OK. And I'll write the card. I know my writing is terrible, but Mum always laughs at the funny pictures I draw in my cards, and she keeps every one. And no, it's not because I broke her cup last week. I've already said sorry for that.
Fine. A cake, some flowers and a funny card. Let's go to the market early on Sunday.

questions.q: Why doesn't Dan want to buy Mum a book?
options: She has too many books already.
She doesn't have time to read.
She reads on her phone now.
questions.explain: she reads everything on her phone now. She hasn't opened a real book for a year——真正的原因是她现在都用手机看书。「书架满了」是 Emma 说的，Dan 说 A full shelf isn't the problem；「没时间」没有人说。

questions.q: What does Emma think about the scarf?
options: It is too warm for this time of year.
questions.explain: It's lovely, and the price is fine, but it's blue. Mum never wears blue——问题在颜色。价钱她说 fine；「下个冬天也能戴」说明季节不是问题。

questions.q: How does Dan feel about making a cake?
options: He is worried it will go wrong.
He thinks it will be easy.
He is too busy to do it.
questions.explain: I'm worried the same thing will happen again——上次做糊了，他怕再失败。「容易」是 Grandma 说的；「有时间」他自己说了 that's not the problem。

questions.q: Why does Emma want to buy the flowers at the market?
options: The flower shop is closed on Sunday.
questions.explain: the market flowers come from the farm that morning, so they're fresh. They stay nice all week——集市的花更新鲜、放得久。价钱 about the same；花店周日是开门的。

questions.q: Why does Dan want to write the card himself?
options: His writing is better than Emma's.
He wants to say sorry for something.
questions.explain: Mum always laughs at the funny pictures I draw in my cards, and she keeps every one——妈妈喜欢他画的画。他自己说 my writing is terrible；打碎杯子已经道过歉，it's not because I broke her cup。

sections.intro: 听 Emma 告诉同学 Leo 五个人各送了妈妈什么生日礼物。把每个人和右边 A-H 的礼物配起来。8 件礼物都会被提到，有 3 件没人送——注意听「最后送的是什么」。

script.text: Hi Emma. Did your mum have a nice birthday on Sunday? What did everyone give her?
She loved everything. My brother and I made a cake and gave her some flowers from the market. They still look fresh today.
Nice. And what did your Aunt Sue give her?
Sue wanted to buy a scarf, but Mum already has three, so in the end she gave her a hat. It's green, Mum's favourite colour.
That was a good idea. What about your Uncle Mark? You said he always gives something big.
He did again! He gave her a camera, a small one for holidays. Dad said it was too much, but Mum was so happy.
Wow. And Alice, the lady next door?
Alice gave her a plant from her garden. It has yellow flowers, and it's already in the kitchen window.
And Rosie? Your mum's best friend?
Rosie gave her a bag, a big blue one for work. And Uncle Ben gave her two tickets for the theatre next month.
The theatre! Lucky her. Did your dad get her something too?
He wanted to buy her a watch, but the shop had sold the one he liked, so he's taking her out for dinner on Friday.
Well, that sounds like a lovely birthday.

questions.explain: Sue wanted to buy a scarf, but Mum already has three, so in the end she gave her a hat——围巾是干扰，最后送的是帽子。
He gave her a camera, a small one for holidays——舅舅送的是相机。
Alice gave her a plant from her garden——邻居送的是自家花园的盆栽。
Rosie gave her a bag, a big blue one for work——好朋友送的是包。
Uncle Ben gave her two tickets for the theatre next month——送的是剧院的票。手表是爸爸想买没买到，flowers 是 Emma 和弟弟送的。
